objective: Close the M08 displayed-prompt-injection test-matrix gap by neutralizing common fake conversation-role control markers inside fresh Vision summaries and proving, across a deterministic adversarial matrix, that screen content remains bounded untrusted user-role data and never becomes system instruction, replay context or executable tool activity.
non_goals: Do not run a real Vision model, Cloud request, desktop capture, GPU benchmark, repeated workflow or soak test.
Do not add a second moderation engine, change the persona, change the 15-second TTL, alter Vision confidence or enable autonomous decision support.
Do not claim that text sanitization alone can guarantee model semantic behavior; structural role separation and policy remain mandatory.
Do not persist screenshots, prompts, summaries, logs or verification artifacts.
Do not open M09 or claim the owner scene-QA accuracy/diversity gate.
contracts: Fresh screen summaries remain exactly one bounded user-role message wrapped by the canonical UNTRUSTED_FRESH_OBSERVATION_DATA boundary.
Vision text never enters the system-role message, and fake role/control markers cannot create additional messages or close the canonical boundary.
Common ChatML, Llama instruction and XML-like role markers are rendered inert while ordinary Vietnamese scene text remains readable.
The observation remains evidence only: toolExecution stays false and replay does not retain the Vision summary.
Malformed, cross-session, non-owner-lane, abstained, expired and historical observations retain their existing fail-closed behavior.
No new dependency, model call, local VRAM use or raw artifact is introduced.
allowed_dependencies: Python standard library and existing repository test tooling.
acceptance_criteria: A deterministic matrix covers at least 24 English/Vietnamese prompt-injection and fake role/control marker variants.
Every matrix case remains one user-role observation block with exactly one canonical opening and closing boundary.
No adversarial payload appears in the system-role prompt or replay data, and no tool execution is enabled.
Ordinary Vietnamese scene descriptions and punctuation remain intact after neutralization.
Text-brain tests and repository fast tests pass.
Module-brief validation, GitNexus change scan and git diff check pass.
required_test_commands: uv run --frozen python -c "import json; from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator; schema=json.load(open('docs/schemas/module-brief.schema.json', encoding='utf-8')); brief=json.load(open('docs/modules/M08-S28-screen-prompt-injection-containment-module-brief.json', encoding='utf-8')); Draft202012Validator(schema).validate(brief)"
uv run --frozen python -m unittest discover -s packages/text-brain/tests -p "test_*.py"
